text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said it filed a counterclaim Wednesday against H.F. Ahmanson and Co related to the thrift's $6.2 billion hostile bid for Great Western.

In a statement, Great Western said the proposed by-law amendment under which Ahmanson is soliciting consents is "illegal" and "unenforceable" and is "an improper intrusion into the statutory powers of the board of directors."

Great Western also denied all material allegations contained in Ahmanson's complaint and said it raised certain affirmative defenses, including "that Ahmanson is acting in its own self interests at the expense of the interests of Great Western and its shareholders and thus comes to court with unclean hands."
The claim was filed in Delaware State Court.
On Tuesday, Great Western postponed its annual meeting from its previously-scheduled date of April 22. A new date has not been set.
Great Western also created an employee severance program that could raise the cost of a takeover from Ahmanson.
Great Western was off 1/8 to 46-3/4. Ahmanson was up 1/2 to 42.
